desc:
Hit a ragdoll and watch it react like a real body. Break an arm and it hangs. Shoot a leg and it limps. Hit hard enough and you'll see the bones.

UPDATE: 6 machines on the Sandbox map. Saw, propeller, battering ram, spiked roller, iron maiden and meat grinder. Carry a ragdoll to the yellow square and see what happens.

What you can do:
- Over 20 weapons: katana, shotgun, chainsaw, lightsaber, freeze ray, grenade launcher, the Force...
- Kick ragdolls through brick walls
- Drive trucks through everything
- Traps: press, wrecking ball, cannon, lava, trampolines, zero gravity
- Slow motion to watch every hit
- A giant shows up. Take him down for his chest
- Play solo or with friends in multiplayer

Daily rewards every day you come back.

Controls: Click = hit, hold = charged hit, E = grab, G = throw, F = kick

Favorite and like the game, we update it every week.
